main_measure.name: mean excess 30-day return after positive-forecast mean_reversion cases (minus the coin's mean 30-day return)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day taken together (day-clustered)

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with day-clustered t >= 2 and supporting check passes; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; else inconclusive; at least 30 independent case-days

supporting_check.name: mean excess return of larger-forecast half minus smaller-forecast half > 0

decided_by: The day-clustered t lies between -2 and 2, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Cases are grid bars (positions 0, 30, 60, ... of each window with a full 30 bars ahead) whose regime is mean_reversion and forecast > 0; the coin's mean 30-day return is taken on the same grid over all its windows; the t sums the cases' deviations per UTC day with a G/(G-1) correction; with an odd number of cases the middle-forecast case is left out of both halves.
